governanceNotes: D1 batch 42 (2026-09-24): deferred on class-scope and parallel-pathway grounds, the gastrointestinal-cancers batch-37 and granulomatous-disease batch-40 pattern. (i) Class/umbrella identity: 'head and neck cancers' aggregates distinct organ-site malignancies (oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, larynx, nasopharynx, sinonasal, salivary gland) whose staging, treatment, and downstream profiles are site-specific; the registry's parallel-pathway class ban (batches 22, 27, 33, 37) prohibits the umbrella from authoring pathways its members will author independently. (ii) Member ownership: laryngeal-cancer is an edge-BEARING published identity (post-laryngectomy total-laryngectomy speech-failure to aphonia pathway) demonstrating member-level ownership, and oral-cancer and salivary-gland-cancer are queued draft member identities with their own windows (wrong-identity and duplicate-scope guards); thyroid-cancer and esophageal-cancer own adjacent windows as published edge-bearing identities. (iii) Common-pathway collision preview: the plausible class-level targets - hearing-loss (platinum ototoxicity and radiation ototoxicity), dysphagia (published identity with its own incoming edge), xerostomia (salivary function loss from radiation), dental caries/loss-of-teeth, depressive-disorder (64-edge family), malnutrition-residuals (oncologic precedent), unexplained-chronic-pain - are site-and-treatment-specific in their evidence: an umbrella edge would either double-count member pathways when oral-cancer, salivary-gland-cancer, and the remaining head-and-neck sites are authored in their own batches, or rest on mixed-site series whose site composition cannot be attributed to the umbrella (parallel-pathway guard). (iv) Treatment-mediated guard: most downstream burden (dysphagia, xerostomia, hearing loss, trismus, dental loss) routes through surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy states owned by treatment-mediated pathways rather than from the malignancy identity itself (treatment-state guard, post-surgical-gigantism batch-38 pattern). (v) Zero-record for umbrella-specific outcomes: targeted screening located no cohort quantifying outcomes attributable to the aggregate 'head and neck cancers' label as distinct from its organ sites (zero-record guard). Reopening condition: qualified-human governance reclassification of the umbrella as the pathway owner (with members retained for identity resolution only), or a directive that class-level authoring precede member authoring with explicit collision handling.
